items.title: Anthropic’s “Down Quarter” Highlights Broadcom’s $161 Billion Risk
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic’s amended S-1 shows third-quarter revenue up about 47% from the second quarter, while compute and infrastructure expenses rose about 78%. Jason Lemkin says Anthropic’s net new bookings fell in the third quarter, even though the company has committed $895 billion to compute.
